XC_SelectCellsByCriteria.caption: Select cells that pass a test, from the Selection menu or Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Q.

XC_TypeColorSelection.caption: Color the selection by cell type: inputs, formulas and links each get their colour.

XC_UnhideRowsCols.caption: Hidden rows and columns come back, all of them or the ones you choose.

XC_ClearDuplicates.caption: Repeat values are blanked out and the first of each stays.
